content: The median cost of premixed insulin products, specifically Aspart 70/30 and Lispro 50/50 or 75/25, in the United States is calculated based on two pricing metrics: the Average Wholesale Price (AWP) and the National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC). For these products, the AWP ranges from $180 to $342 per 1,000 units, while the NADAC ranges from $145 to $274 per 1,000 units. For NPH/regular 70/30 insulin products, the AWP falls between $172 and $208 per 1,000 units, whereas the NADAC ranges from $132 to $303 per 1,000 units.
